label.en: The evolution of atomic structure models

cues.title: 看不见原子，凭什么改画法？
cues.titleEn: What can make us redraw an unseen atom?
cues.caption: 光点为何偏向正极板？
cues.captionEn: Why does the spot bend toward +?
cues.zh: 如果原子看不见，凭什么把它画成一个实心球？道尔顿的图先提出不可再分的假设。现在看阴极射线留下的光点：接通电场，它偏向正极板；把极性反过来，偏转也反过来。跟住射线中的带电部分，受力方向指向它带负电。光点是可观察的证据，还不是原子的照片。
cues.en: How can we redraw something too small to see? Dalton’s solid sphere begins with an indivisible-atom hypothesis. Now watch the spot made by cathode rays. An electric field bends it toward the positive plate. Reverse the plates, and the deflection reverses. Follow the charged component: its force direction identifies negative charge. The spot is observable evidence, not a photograph of an atom.

cues.title: 换材料，证据还在吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the evidence survive a change of material?
cues.caption: 换材料，共同成分仍在。
cues.captionEn: New material; the shared component remains.
cues.zh: 如果这种负电成分只是某种气体或电极的特殊产物，换材料会怎样？汤姆孙改变气体和阴极材料，仍得到同一数量级的质量与电荷之比。图上保留原报告的差异，没有把它们改成完全相等。共同的负电成分进入原子模型，不可再分的假设必须修改。中性原子还需要正电荷；把它铺满整个球，是接下来要检验的模型假设。
cues.en: What if this negative component belongs only to one gas or electrode? Thomson changed both and still obtained mass-to-charge ratios of the same order. These fixed records retain the differences in his report; they have not been forced to agree. A common negative component enters the atom, challenging indivisibility. Neutrality also requires positive charge. Spreading that charge through a sphere is a new hypothesis to test.

cues.title: 哪种分布能把粒子弹回来？
cues.titleEn: Which charge distribution can turn a particle back?
cues.caption: 相同电荷，为什么一个能折返？
cues.captionEn: Same charge: why can only one turn it back?
cues.zh: 有少数阿尔法粒子发生了大角度散射。弥散的正电荷能做到吗？让同样的总正电荷，分别铺在大球里、集中到很小的中心。跟住这次五兆电子伏的正对入射：弥散球的最高势垒还不到入射能量的千分之一，粒子穿过去；集中核让势能不断升高，直到动能用尽，粒子折返。现在预测：能量更高，会靠得更近吗？会。这个对照说明电荷集中为什么重要；现代参数用于检验解释，没有替代当年的散射记录。
cues.en: A few alpha particles scatter through large angles. Can diffuse positive charge explain that? Give a broad sphere and a compact centre the same total charge. Follow a five megaelectronvolt head-on test. The sphere’s highest barrier is less than a thousandth of the incident energy, so the particle passes through. Near the compact centre, potential energy rises until kinetic energy reaches zero and the particle turns back. Predict: does more energy bring it closer? Yes. This modern calculation tests the explanation; it does not replace the historical observations.

cues.title: 一条谱线怎样检验一个能级差？
cues.titleEn: How can a spectral line test an energy gap?
cues.caption: 更大的能级差，会给出什么光？
cues.captionEn: A larger gap: what light should follow?
cues.zh: 氢发出的光有固定的谱线，并不是任何颜色都一样亮。玻尔提出允许的离散能量，并用两个能级的差决定一个光子的能量。跟住这份能量：从第三级到第二级，差值对应红光。保持第二级不变，改从第四级出发，先猜波长会怎样。能量差更大，波长更短，预测落到蓝绿谱线附近。固定记录没有跟着模型移动。光谱支持能级关系，却没有拍到电子走圆圈；接下来，我们换一种方式表达电子的空间分布。
cues.en: Hydrogen emits fixed spectral lines rather than every colour equally. Bohr proposed discrete allowed energies, with one photon carrying the difference between two levels. Follow that energy: level three to level two corresponds to red light. Keep level two, but start at level four. Predict the wavelength before revealing it. A larger gap gives a shorter wavelength, near the blue-green line. The fixed records do not move with the model. Spectra support energy relationships without photographing circular paths. Next, we need a different picture of the electron’s spatial distribution.

cues.title: 电子云不是一群电子
cues.titleEn: An electron cloud is not many electrons
cues.caption: 许多小点表示同一状态的概率分布，不表示许多电子。
cues.captionEn: Many dots represent one state’s probability distribution, not many electrons.
cues.zh: 氢原子只有一个电子，为什么电子云图里会有这么多小点？这些点是对同一种量子状态的概率分布进行采样。点越来越多，分布的轮廓更清楚，电子数却没有增加。这张图没有把点依次连成轨迹，也没有说电子沿某条看不见的圆圈运动。
cues.en: Hydrogen has one electron, so why does its cloud contain so many dots? They sample the probability distribution of the same quantum state. More samples reveal the distribution more clearly without increasing the number of electrons. The dots are not joined into a trajectory, and the picture does not imply an unseen circular orbit.

cues.title: 轮廓包围的是概率
cues.caption: 概率轮廓不是硬边界，轮廓之外仍有非零概率。
cues.captionEn: A probability contour is not a hard boundary; probability remains outside it.
cues.zh: 教材用包围百分之九十概率的空间简化电子云轮廓。这里逐渐扩大氢原子一s态的球，累计概率从一半增加到九成。淡色点仍可在球外出现，所以轮廓不是电子无法穿过的墙。圆形只是三维球面的投影，概率按三维体积计算。
cues.en: The textbook simplifies a cloud with a region enclosing ninety percent probability. Here a sphere expands in hydrogen’s one-s state, raising cumulative probability from one half to nine tenths. Faint samples can still lie outside it, so the contour is not an impenetrable wall. The circle projects a sphere, and probability is calculated in three-dimensional volume.

cues.title: 球对称不等于相同大小
cues.titleEn: Spherical symmetry does not mean equal size
cues.caption: 同一长度尺度下，2s比1s更弥散。
cues.captionEn: On the same length scale, 2s is more diffuse than 1s.
cues.zh: 把一s和二s放到同一个长度尺度下，两者都具有球对称，但二s向更远的空间展开。并不是把同一个小球机械放大：二s的径向分布还有一个节点。这里展示的是氢原子的解析状态，不能把这些半径直接套给所有多电子原子。
cues.en: At a common length scale, both one-s and two-s are spherically symmetric, but two-s extends farther. It is not merely the same small sphere enlarged: its radial distribution also has a node. These are analytic hydrogen states, so their radii should not be copied directly to every many-electron atom.

cues.title: p轨道的三个取向
cues.caption: 2p的三个取向相互垂直，每一幅都是单独的概率分布。
cues.captionEn: The three 2p orientations are perpendicular; each view is a separate probability distribution.
cues.zh: p态不再是球对称，概率分布沿一个方向形成两个主要区域。教材用x、y、z三个相互垂直的方向区分p轨道。画面把它们分别投影出来，不能把三幅图的小点加起来当作一个原子里更多的电子。轨道在这里描述量子状态，已经不是前面历史模型的圆形路线。
cues.en: A p state is not spherically symmetric: its probability distribution has two main regions along one direction. The textbook distinguishes p orbitals along three perpendicular x, y and z directions. Each is projected separately, so their dots should not be added as extra electrons in one atom. Orbital now describes a quantum state, not the circular route in the historical models.

question.zh: 看不见原子，凭什么改变原子模型？
question.en: What evidence can change a model of an unseen atom?

lead.zh: 跟住偏转的射线、折返的粒子和发出的光，看看哪条证据让旧图像不够用了。
lead.en: Follow a deflected beam, a returning particle and emitted light to see where an old picture fails.

principle.zh: 模型须接受独立证据检验。共同负电成分要求内部结构，大角度散射要求集中电荷，谱线检验能级差；现代电子云表达状态的概率而非轨迹。
principle.en: Models face independent evidence: shared negative components require internal structure, large deflections require concentrated charge, and spectral lines test energy gaps. A cloud describes state probability, not a trajectory.

question.zh: 把正对入射的α粒子能量加倍，集中核模型预测它离核更近还是更远？
question.en: Double the energy of a head-on alpha particle. Does the compact-charge model predict a nearer or farther turning point?

explanation.zh: 更近。固定核库仑近似中 r_min=kqQ/E，能量加倍，转折距离减半。历史记录仍保持原样，改变的是候选模型的预测。
explanation.en: Nearer. In the fixed-centre Coulomb approximation, r_min=kqQ/E: doubling energy halves the distance. Historical records stay fixed while the candidate prediction changes.

question.zh: 一个电子，为什么画成许多点？
question.en: Why draw one electron as many dots?

lead.zh: 先增加采样点，再扩大概率球，最后用同一标尺比较节点和取向。
lead.en: Add samples, expand a probability sphere, then compare nodes and orientations on shared scales.

principle.zh: 点采样同一量子状态的概率分布。90%轮廓没有硬边界；节点和取向是分布结构，不能把图上的点相加当电子数。
principle.en: Dots sample one state’s probability distribution. A 90% contour is not a wall; nodes and orientations describe the distribution, not extra electrons.

question.zh: 把采样点从100增加到900，90%球的解析半径和电子数会变吗？
question.en: Increase samples from 100 to 900. Do the analytic 90% radius or electron count change?

explanation.zh: 都不变。更多点让同一分布更清楚；概率球由同一三维解析累计概率决定。
explanation.en: Neither changes. More dots resolve the same distribution; the sphere comes from the same analytic three-dimensional probability.

translations.历史图不是实测原子照片；核与电子尺寸夸大。电子云使用氢原子非相对论概率模型，三维: Historical views are not atomic photographs; nucleus and electron sizes are exaggerated. Clouds project samples of nonrelativistic hydrogen probability, without a continuous trajectory.

modelBoundaries: Beam geometry is a modern controlled uniform-field illustration, not reconstructed 1897 spot coordinates. Historical m/e records are immutable raw original units; no artificial perfect agreement. Transverse display distance uses an independent enlarged scale; horizontal and vertical scales differ.

Rutherford visual compares equal positive charge with an electron-free diffuse sphere as a positive-potential upper bound and a fixed point centre. Modern 5/10MeV +79e parameters do not represent measured1911 inputs. Head-on reflection explains possibility, not scattering statistics or charge-sign identification.

Hydrogen level predictions use reduced mass and vacuum wavelength. NIST selected observed fine components are in air, separately labelled; 1nm display is not an exact fine-structure fit. Intensity is illustrative.
Cloud sampling analytic nonrelativistic hydrogen, not trajectories. Existing finite sampling-tail caveat retained; no many-electron radii.
Scattering scenes have independent normalized physical time laws and are played sequentially; equal film progress does not mean equal physical flight time.
